metadata.question: Does forest cover decrease in the area near Banamepe along the Digul River between November 2002 and November 2019?

data.raw_code: The user is asking about forest cover change near Banamepe along the Digul River between November 2002 and November 2019. This requires: 1. Location: Banamepe along the Digul River in Indonesia. I'll create a point geometry and buffer it to create an AOI. 2. Time period: November 2002 vs November 2019 3. Data: Need satellite imagery that covers both time periods. Landsat 7 would work for 2002, but has the SLC-off issue after 2003. Landsat 8 would work for 2019. I could use MODIS for consistent data across both periods. 4. Forest cover proxy: NDVI is a good indicator of vegetation health and forest cover. Strategy: - Use MODIS Vegetation Indices (MOD13Q1) for consistent data across both time periods - Calculate mean NDVI for November 2002 and November 2019 - Compare the values to see if there's a decrease - Handle potential data gaps and validation Let me use MODIS MOD13Q1 which has 16-day composites at 250m resolution, suitable for forest monitoring. Steps: 1. Define AOI around Banamepe (approx coordinates: -5.9, 140.5) 2. Get MODIS NDVI for November 2002 and November 2019 3. Calculate mean NDVI for each period 4. Compare and determine if forest cover decreased 5. Handle edge cases (no data, no valid pixels, etc.) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const banamepe = ee.Geometry.Point([140.5, -5.9]); // Approximate location of Banamepe const aoi = banamepe.buffer(10000); // 10km buffer around Banamepe const nov2002_start = '2002-11-01'; const nov2002_end = '2002-11-30'; const nov2019_start = '2019-11-01'; const nov2019_end = '2019-11-30'; // 2. Data Acquisition - Using MODIS Vegetation Indices for consistent data const modis2002 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterDate(nov2002_start, nov2002_end) .filterBounds(aoi); const modis2019 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/061/MOD13Q1') .filterDate(nov2019_start, nov2019_end) .filterBounds(aoi); // Check collection sizes const count2002 = modis2002.size().getInfo(); const count2019 = modis2019.size().getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Images: ${count2002}`); console.log(`2019 Images: ${count2019}`); if (count2002 === 0 || count2019 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // 3. Processing - Calculate mean NDVI for each period const ndvi2002 = modis2002.select('NDVI').mean().multiply(0.0001); // Scale factor const ndvi2019 = modis2019.select('NDVI').mean().multiply(0.0001); // Count valid pixels const count2002_pixels = ndvi2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const count2019_pixels = ndvi2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Valid Pixels: ${count2002_pixels}`); console.log(`2019 Valid Pixels: ${count2019_pixels}`); if (count2002_pixels === 0 || count2019_pixels === 0) { console.log("C2"); return; } // 4. Calculation - Get mean NDVI values const mean2002 = ndvi2002.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); const mean2019 = ndvi2019.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean(), geometry: aoi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }).get('NDVI').getInfo(); console.log(`2002 Mean NDVI: ${mean2002 ? mean2002.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); console.log(`2019 Mean NDVI: ${mean2019 ? mean2019.toFixed(3) : 'null'}`); // 5. Validation & Final Answer if (mean2002 === null || mean2019 === null || isNaN(mean2002) || isNaN(mean2019) || mean2002 > 1 || mean2019 > 1 || mean2002 < -1 || mean2019 < -1) { console.log("C3"); } else if (mean2019 < mean2002) { console.log("Forest cover decreased (NDVI lower in 2019)"); console.log("A"); } else { console.log("Forest cover did not decrease"); console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
